title: Meridian Customer Retention
description: Meridian Bank customer-retention analytics for Marcus Bell (EVP Consumer & Small Business Banking). A competitor rate promotion ~3 weeks ago pushed ~220 high-value customers with maturing CDs into attrition risk (~$159M balance-at-risk, ~$4.1M revenue-at-risk).
sample_questions: How much balance is at risk right now, and what's the revenue at risk?
Which customer tiers is the risk concentrated in?
What are these at-risk customers holding?
CUST-0000214 is high-risk — how much is at stake and what are they holding?
What's the next best action for CUST-0000214, and how much would it retain?
Across all at-risk customers, how much could we retain, and by which action?
Which at-risk customers are best served by a cross-sell instead of a retention offer?

example_sqls.question: How much balance is at risk?
example_sqls.sql: SELECT MEASURE(`balance_at_risk`) AS balance_at_risk, MEASURE(`revenue_at_risk`) AS revenue_at_risk FROM techsummit_27.meridian_bank.mv_customer_risk

example_sqls.question: Which customer tiers is the risk concentrated in?
example_sqls.sql: SELECT tier, MEASURE(`atrisk_count`) AS atrisk_count, MEASURE(`balance_at_risk`) AS balance_at_risk FROM techsummit_27.meridian_bank.mv_customer_risk GROUP BY tier ORDER BY balance_at_risk DESC

example_sqls.question: CUST-0000214 is high-risk — how much is at stake?
example_sqls.sql: SELECT customer_id, tier, tenure_years, attrition_risk_score, balance_at_risk_usd, revenue_at_risk_usd, atrisk_product_id, atrisk_balance_usd, days_to_maturity FROM techsummit_27.meridian_bank.gold_open_atrisk WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0000214'

example_sqls.question: What's the next best action for CUST-0000214?
example_sqls.sql: SELECT customer_id, recommended_action, predicted_retained_usd, predicted_net_value_usd, action_ranking FROM techsummit_27.meridian_bank.gold_nba_recommendations WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0000214'

example_sqls.question: Across all at-risk customers, how much could we retain?
example_sqls.sql: SELECT recommended_action, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, SUM(predicted_retained_usd) AS total_retained FROM techsummit_27.meridian_bank.gold_nba_recommendations GROUP BY recommended_action ORDER BY total_retained DESC
